parameters.command:
=cd /path/to/Policy-Aware-AI-Investment-Copilot && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from pathlib import Path
from agentic_app.core.market_intelligence import get_market_intelligence
from agentic_app.core.question_generator import generate_diligence_questions
from agentic_app.core.memo_generator import generate_investment_memo
from agentic_app.core.report_generator import generate_html_report

startup = json.loads(open('/tmp/{{ $json.policy_result.startup.replace(\" \", \"_\").lower() }}.startup.json').read())
policy_result = {{ $json.policy_result | json }}

intel = get_market_intelligence(startup)
questions = generate_diligence_questions(startup, policy_result, intel)
memo = generate_investment_memo(startup, policy_result, intel, questions)
report_html = generate_html_report(startup, policy_result, intel, questions, memo, '{{ $json.analyst_notes }}')

report_path = '/tmp/{{ $json.policy_result.startup.replace(\" \", \"_\").lower() }}_report.html'
open(report_path, 'w').write(report_html)
print(report_path)
"
